parameters.query:
BEGIN;
SELECT
  $1::uuid AS analysis_run_id,
  NULLIF($2::text, '')::uuid AS agentic_job_id,
  NULLIF($2::text, '') IS NOT NULL AS agentic_promoted,
  set_config('tender.analysis_run_id', $1::text, true) AS run_setting,
  set_config('tender.agentic_job_id', COALESCE($2::text, ''), true) AS job_setting;
DO $agentic_promotion$
DECLARE
  v_run_id uuid := current_setting('tender.analysis_run_id')::uuid;
  v_job_text text := current_setting('tender.agentic_job_id');
  v_job_id uuid;
  v_job public.tender_agentic_jobs%ROWTYPE;
  v_run_status text;
  v_actual_count integer;
  v_actual_keys text[];
  v_existing_count integer;
  v_existing_keys text[];
  v_expected_keys constant text[] := ARRAY['procurement_subject','nm_price_with_vat','platform','procedure_type','application_deadline','application_review_date','results_date','customer','customer_contacts','participation_cost','participation_guarantee','evaluation_criteria','delivery_term','payment_terms','special_account_or_treasury','bank_support','government_contract','rebidding','national_regime','advance_contract_guarantee','warranty_obligations_guarantee','licenses_certificates','required_official_certificates','similar_supply_experience','analog_allowed','analog_definition','application_documents']::text[];
BEGIN
  IF v_job_text = '' THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  v_job_id := v_job_text::uuid;

  SELECT status
    INTO v_run_status
    FROM public.tender_analysis_runs
   WHERE id = v_run_id
   FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'AGENTIC_PROMOTION_RUN_NOT_FOUND';
  END IF;

  SELECT *
    INTO v_job
    FROM public.tender_agentic_jobs
   WHERE id = v_job_id
   FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND
     OR v_job.status <> 'completed'
     OR v_job.analysis_run_id <> v_run_id
     OR v_job.pipeline_version <> 'tender_agentic_pipeline_v1'
     OR v_job.field_catalog_version <> 'tender_fields_v1'
     OR btrim(v_job.model) = ''
     OR btrim(v_job.reasoning_effort) = ''
     OR COALESCE(v_job.field_catalog_sha256, '') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
     OR COALESCE(v_job.input_manifest_sha256, '') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
     OR COALESCE(v_job.artifacts->>'raw_result_sha256', '') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
     OR COALESCE(v_job.artifacts->>'validated_result_sha256', '') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'AGENTIC_PROMOTION_JOB_IDENTITY_INVALID';
  END IF;

  IF v_job.expected_documents <> v_job.staged_documents
     OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.tender_agentic_documents WHERE job_id = v_job_id) <> v_job.expected_documents
     OR EXISTS (
       SELECT 1
         FROM public.tender_agentic_documents
        WHERE job_id = v_job_id
          AND (status <> 'staged'
            OR COALESCE(source_sha256, '') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
            OR COALESCE(staged_sha256, '') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
     ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'AGENTIC_PROMOTION_DOCUMENT_IDENTITY_INVALID';
  END IF;

  PERFORM 1
    FROM public.tender_agentic_field_results
   WHERE job_id = v_job_id
   FOR UPDATE;

  SELECT count(*)::integer, array_agg(field_key ORDER BY field_index)
    INTO v_actual_count, v_actual_keys
    FROM public.tender_agentic_field_results
   WHERE job_id = v_job_id;

  IF v_actual_count <> 27 OR v_actual_keys IS DISTINCT FROM v_expected_keys THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'AGENTIC_PROMOTION_FIELD_SET_INVALID';
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
      FROM public.tender_agentic_field_results
     WHERE job_id = v_job_id
       AND (analysis_run_id <> v_run_id
         OR field_catalog_version <> 'tender_fields_v1'
         OR status NOT IN ('resolved', 'requires_review', 'not_found')
         OR (status = 'resolved' AND NULLIF(btrim(value_text), '') IS NULL)
         OR (status = 'not_found' AND value_text IS NOT NULL))
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'AGENTIC_PROMOTION_FIELD_CONTRACT_INVALID';
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
      FROM public.tender_agentic_field_results af
     WHERE af.job_id = v_job_id
       AND af.status IN ('resolved', 'requires_review')
       AND (
         jsonb_typeof(af.result_json->'evidence') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
         OR jsonb_array_length(af.result_json->'evidence') = 0
         OR EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
             FROM jsonb_array_elements(af.result_json->'evidence') evidence_item
             LEFT JOIN public.tender_agentic_documents agent_document
               ON agent_document.job_id = v_job_id
              AND agent_document.artifact_key = evidence_item->>'artifact_key'
            WHERE NULLIF(btrim(evidence_item->>'artifact_key'), '') IS NULL
               OR NULLIF(btrim(evidence_item->>'locator'), '') IS NULL
               OR agent_document.job_id IS NULL
         )
       )
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'AGENTIC_PROMOTION_EVIDENCE_REFERENCE_INVALID';
  END IF;

  PERFORM 1
    FROM public.tender_analysis_field_results
   WHERE analysis_run_id = v_run_id
   FOR UPDATE;

  SELECT count(*)::integer, array_agg(field_key ORDER BY field_index)
    INTO v_existing_count, v_existing_keys
    FROM public.tender_analysis_field_results
   WHERE analysis_run_id = v_run_id;

  IF v_existing_count NOT IN (0, 27)
     OR (v_existing_count = 27 AND v_existing_keys IS DISTINCT FROM v_expected_keys)
     OR EXISTS (
       SELECT 1
         FROM public.tender_analysis_field_results
        WHERE analysis_run_id = v_run_id
          AND resolution_method <> 'codex_agentic_v1'
     ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'AGENTIC_PROMOTION_MIXED_PRODUCER';
  END IF;

  IF v_existing_count = 27 AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
      FROM public.tender_analysis_field_results
     WHERE analysis_run_id = v_run_id
       AND COALESCE(result_json #>> '{audit,agentic_job_id}', '') <> v_job_id::text
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'AGENTIC_PROMOTION_DIFFERENT_AGENTIC_JOB';
  END IF;

  IF (v_existing_count = 0 AND v_run_status <> 'processing')
     OR (v_existing_count = 27 AND v_run_status NOT IN ('aggregating', 'completed')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'AGENTIC_PROMOTION_LIFECYCLE_INVALID';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.tender_analysis_field_results (
    analysis_run_id,
    field_catalog_version,
    result_contract_version,
    field_index,
    field_key,
    status,
    value_text,
    confidence,
    requires_human_review,
    resolution_method,
    result_json
  )
  SELECT
    v_run_id,
    'tender_fields_v1',
    'tender_field_final_v1',
    af.field_index,
    af.field_key,
    af.status,
    CASE WHEN af.status = 'not_found' THEN NULL ELSE af.value_text END,
    NULL::numeric,
    af.status = 'requires_review',
    'codex_agentic_v1',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'result_contract_version', 'tender_field_final_v1',
      'analysis_run_id', v_run_id::text,
      'field_catalog_version', 'tender_fields_v1',
      'field_index', af.field_index,
      'field_key', af.field_key,
      'status', af.status,
      'value_text', CASE WHEN af.status = 'not_found' THEN NULL ELSE af.value_text END,
      'confidence', NULL,
      'requires_human_review', af.status = 'requires_review',
      'resolution_method', 'codex_agentic_v1',
      'evidence', CASE
        WHEN af.status = 'not_found' THEN '[]'::jsonb
        ELSE (
          SELECT COALESCE(
            jsonb_agg(
              evidence_item || jsonb_build_object('document', source_document.file_name)
              ORDER BY evidence_ordinality
            ),
            '[]'::jsonb
          )
            FROM jsonb_array_elements(af.result_json->'evidence') WITH ORDINALITY AS evidence(evidence_item, evidence_ordinality)
            JOIN public.tender_agentic_documents agent_document
              ON agent_document.job_id = v_job_id
             AND agent_document.artifact_key = evidence_item->>'artifact_key'
            JOIN public.tender_analysis_documents source_document
              ON source_document.id = agent_document.source_document_id
             AND source_document.analysis_run_id = v_run_id
        )
      END,
      'review', CASE
        WHEN af.status = 'requires_review' THEN jsonb_build_object(
          'reason_code', 'codex_agentic_requires_review',
          'note', NULLIF(btrim(af.result_json->>'rationale'), '')
        )
        ELSE NULL
      END,
      'not_found', CASE
        WHEN af.status = 'not_found' THEN jsonb_build_object(
          'scope', 'provided_sources',
          'reason_code', 'not_found_after_agentic_analysis',
          'note', NULLIF(btrim(af.result_json->>'rationale'), '')
        )
        ELSE NULL
      END,
      'audit', jsonb_build_object(
        'producer', 'codex_agentic_v1',
        'agentic_job_id', v_job_id::text,
        'pipeline_version', v_job.pipeline_version,
        'model', v_job.model,
        'reasoning_effort', v_job.reasoning_effort,
        'field_catalog_sha256', v_job.field_catalog_sha256,
        'input_manifest_sha256', v_job.input_manifest_sha256,
        'raw_result_sha256', v_job.artifacts->>'raw_result_sha256',
        'validated_result_sha256', v_job.artifacts->>'validated_result_sha256'
      ),
      'agent_result', af.result_json
    )
  FROM public.tender_agentic_field_results af
  WHERE af.job_id = v_job_id
  ON CONFLICT (analysis_run_id, field_key) DO UPDATE SET
    field_catalog_version = EXCLUDED.field_catalog_version,
    result_contract_version = EXCLUDED.result_contract_version,
    field_index = EXCLUDED.field_index,
    status = EXCLUDED.status,
    value_text = EXCLUDED.value_text,
    confidence = EXCLUDED.confidence,
    requires_human_review = EXCLUDED.requires_human_review,
    resolution_method = EXCLUDED.resolution_method,
    result_json = EXCLUDED.result_json,
    updated_at = NOW();

  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.tender_analysis_field_results WHERE analysis_run_id = v_run_id) <> 27
     OR (SELECT array_agg(field_key ORDER BY field_index) FROM public.tender_analysis_field_results WHERE analysis_run_id = v_run_id) IS DISTINCT FROM v_expected_keys
     OR EXISTS (
       SELECT 1
         FROM public.tender_analysis_field_results
        WHERE analysis_run_id = v_run_id
          AND (resolution_method <> 'codex_agentic_v1'
            OR COALESCE(result_json #>> '{audit,agentic_job_id}', '') <> v_job_id::text)
     ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'AGENTIC_PROMOTION_PERSISTED_CONTRACT_INVALID';
  END IF;

  IF v_run_status = 'processing' THEN
    UPDATE public.tender_analysis_runs
       SET status = 'aggregating',
           aggregation_started_at = COALESCE(aggregation_started_at, NOW()),
           updated_at = NOW()
     WHERE id = v_run_id
       AND status = 'processing';
    IF NOT FOUND THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'AGENTIC_PROMOTION_LIFECYCLE_CLAIM_LOST';
    END IF;
  END IF;
END
$agentic_promotion$;
COMMIT;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.analysis_run_id, $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.agentic_job_id ?? null] }}

parameters.query:
WITH expected_fields(field_index, field_key) AS (
    VALUES
        (1,  'procurement_subject'),
        (2,  'nm_price_with_vat'),
        (3,  'platform'),
        (4,  'procedure_type'),
        (5,  'application_deadline'),
        (6,  'application_review_date'),
        (7,  'results_date'),
        (8,  'customer'),
        (9,  'customer_contacts'),
        (10, 'participation_cost'),
        (11, 'participation_guarantee'),
        (12, 'evaluation_criteria'),
        (13, 'delivery_term'),
        (14, 'payment_terms'),
        (15, 'special_account_or_treasury'),
        (16, 'bank_support'),
        (17, 'government_contract'),
        (18, 'rebidding'),
        (19, 'national_regime'),
        (20, 'advance_contract_guarantee'),
        (21, 'warranty_obligations_guarantee'),
        (22, 'licenses_certificates'),
        (23, 'required_official_certificates'),
        (24, 'similar_supply_experience'),
        (25, 'analog_allowed'),
        (26, 'analog_definition'),
        (27, 'application_documents')
),

run_state AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        status
    FROM tender_analysis_runs
    WHERE id = $1::uuid
),

actual_fields AS (
    SELECT
        field_index,
        field_key,
        field_catalog_version,
        result_contract_version,
        status
    FROM tender_analysis_field_results
    WHERE analysis_run_id = $1::uuid
),

stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*)::int AS final_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE status IN (
                'resolved',
                'requires_review',
                'not_found'
            )
        )::int AS valid_status_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE field_catalog_version = 'tender_fields_v1'
        )::int AS valid_catalog_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE result_contract_version = 'tender_field_final_v1'
        )::int AS valid_contract_count
    FROM actual_fields
),

missing_fields AS (
    SELECT ARRAY_AGG(
        e.field_key
        ORDER BY e.field_index
    ) AS keys
    FROM expected_fields e
    LEFT JOIN actual_fields a
        ON a.field_index = e.field_index
       AND a.field_key = e.field_key
    WHERE a.field_key IS NULL
),

unexpected_fields AS (
    SELECT ARRAY_AGG(
        a.field_key
        ORDER BY a.field_index
    ) AS keys
    FROM actual_fields a
    LEFT JOIN expected_fields e
        ON e.field_index = a.field_index
       AND e.field_key = a.field_key
    WHERE e.field_key IS NULL
),

invalid_status_fields AS (
    SELECT ARRAY_AGG(
        field_key
        ORDER BY field_index
    ) AS keys
    FROM actual_fields
    WHERE status NOT IN (
        'resolved',
        'requires_review',
        'not_found'
    )
),

invalid_catalog_fields AS (
    SELECT ARRAY_AGG(
        field_key
        ORDER BY field_index
    ) AS keys
    FROM actual_fields
    WHERE field_catalog_version <> 'tender_fields_v1'
),

invalid_contract_fields AS (
    SELECT ARRAY_AGG(
        field_key
        ORDER BY field_index
    ) AS keys
    FROM actual_fields
    WHERE result_contract_version <> 'tender_field_final_v1'
),

barrier AS (
    SELECT
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM run_state
        ) AS run_exists,

        (SELECT status FROM run_state LIMIT 1) AS run_status_before,

        s.final_count,

        COALESCE(m.keys, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS missing_keys,
        COALESCE(u.keys, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS unexpected_keys,
        COALESCE(ist.keys, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS invalid_status_keys,
        COALESCE(ic.keys, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS invalid_catalog_keys,
        COALESCE(irc.keys, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS invalid_contract_keys,

        (
            s.final_count = 27
            AND s.valid_status_count = 27
            AND s.valid_catalog_count = 27
            AND s.valid_contract_count = 27
            AND COALESCE(cardinality(m.keys), 0) = 0
            AND COALESCE(cardinality(u.keys), 0) = 0
        ) AS barrier_ready

    FROM stats s
    CROSS JOIN missing_fields m
    CROSS JOIN unexpected_fields u
    CROSS JOIN invalid_status_fields ist
    CROSS JOIN invalid_catalog_fields ic
    CROSS JOIN invalid_contract_fields irc
),

completion_claim AS (
    UPDATE tender_analysis_runs r
    SET
        status = 'completed',
        completed_at = COALESCE(r.completed_at, NOW()),
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM barrier b
    WHERE r.id = $1::uuid
      AND r.status = 'aggregating'
      AND b.barrier_ready = true
    RETURNING r.id
)

SELECT
    $1::uuid AS analysis_run_id,

    b.run_exists,
    b.run_status_before,
    b.final_count,
    b.barrier_ready,

    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM completion_claim
    ) AS completion_claimed,

    b.missing_keys,
    b.unexpected_keys,
    b.invalid_status_keys,
    b.invalid_catalog_keys,
    b.invalid_contract_keys,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT b.run_exists
            THEN 'run_not_found'

        WHEN b.barrier_ready
             AND b.run_status_before = 'ready_for_aggregation'
            THEN 'invalid_lifecycle_ready_for_aggregation'

        WHEN b.barrier_ready
             AND b.run_status_before NOT IN ('aggregating', 'completed')
            THEN 'invalid_lifecycle_status'

        WHEN b.barrier_ready
             AND b.run_status_before = 'completed'
            THEN 'already_completed'

        WHEN NOT b.barrier_ready
            THEN 'waiting_for_final_fields'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM completion_claim
        )
            THEN 'completed_now'

        ELSE 'completion_not_claimed'
    END AS finalization_state

FROM barrier b;
